---
title: AI Discovery Card Catalog
description: Paraphrased capability prompts organized by the Microsoft AI Discovery Cards 5.1 identifiers and categories.
---

## Provenance and use

This catalog preserves the identifiers, titles, and categories attributed to the
Microsoft AI Discovery Cards 5.1 English print set. The capability prompts are
original paraphrases created for this repository from a user-supplied card list;
they are not quotations from the print set.

The exact redistribution terms and public download location for the 5.1 print set
were not independently verified. Related official Microsoft workshop resources
include the [AI Discovery Agent](https://github.com/microsoft/ai-discovery-agent)
and [AI Use Cases Discover and Define](https://github.com/microsoft/dstoolkit-DiscoveryEnvisioning)
repositories. Do not present these related repositories as the source of the exact
5.1 wording.

Use each entry as an ideation prompt, not as a recommendation or assurance that AI
is appropriate for a particular context.

## Agentic

| Card ID | Title                        | Capability prompt                                                                    |
|---------|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| AG01    | Process optimization         | Coordinate, route, and schedule work across a multi-step operational process.        |
| AG02    | Routing and logistics        | Adapt the movement of goods, people, or resources as operating conditions change.    |
| AG03    | Productivity                 | Handle repeatable administrative or knowledge tasks while people focus on judgment.  |
| AG04    | Retail and marketing         | Support personalized engagement, research, and campaign execution.                   |
| AG05    | Software development         | Assist with code creation, review, setup, and other software delivery tasks.          |
| AG06    | Security operations          | Help security teams detect threats, curate intelligence, and coordinate responses.   |
| AG07    | Decision making              | Interpret context and carry out bounded actions from natural-language instructions.  |
| AG08    | Customer service             | Gather information, handle routine requests, and assist human service workers.        |
| AG09    | Onboarding assistant         | Guide onboarding, collect required details, and complete approved account setup.      |
| AG10    | Proactive action             | Notice emerging system issues and propose a response or human escalation.             |
| AG11    | Personalized recommendations | Adapt suggested content or actions from behavior and journey context.                 |
| AG12    | Compliance and audit         | Record actions and provide reviewable explanations or procedural guidance.            |
